attributes.name: Corrosive Storm
attributes.powers: Display this card when a character encounters a monster. While displayed, add 2d6 and the Acid trait to combat checks to defeat monsters.
attributes.recharge: At the end of the turn, each other character is dealt 1 Acid damage, and if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at an Arcane 14 check to recharge it instead.

corrections.corrected_text: Change "Place this card in front of you" to "Display this card" on the following cards:Toxic Cloud (Chapter 2)Incendiary Cloud (Chapter 3)Blizzard (Chapter 5)Corrosive Storm (Chapter 6)Also, on the loot Emerald Codex (Chapter 4), change "place the spells faceup next to your character card" to "display the spells".
corrections.issue: Are there any cards that use the "display" action?
